targetText: There are people who consider the population problem the most important and pressing problem, because "overpopulation" threatens us, is, in fact, already at hand.
summary: Refuting Thomas Malthus's reactionary theory of overpopulation, Bebel proves with agricultural and scientific data that the earth can abundantly feed many times its current population once land and science are freed from capitalist artificial scarcity, while emancipated women will freely regulate childbearing.
